verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost identical. Both stack the headline, the phone in its circle, the rotated ONLINE ONLY pill, the Try It button and the subline from top to bottom, which suits a tall skyscraper. Both share the same flaws. The subline 'New botanical sparkling, out now.' drops below the CTA, which breaks the original reading order. It is also set as large as the button label, so the hierarchy is weak. The left-aligned copy clashes with the centred badge and button. The badge and button nearly touch the side edges and are jammed together. The only visible difference is the phone: in B it pokes slightly above the circle, like the original, while in A it sits a touch lower inside the circle. That is not enough to separate them.
